verdicts.reason: A: the 'Online Only' badge sits right on top of the 'Try It' button, so the call to action can't be read; the button's edges look torn, the phone's circle backdrop has mostly vanished, and the bottom third of the canvas is empty. B keeps every element whole and readable with a strong headline and CTA, but it is cramped: the phone circle is cut off at the left edge, the button and badge are jammed against the bottom-right corner, and the badge almost touches the subline.
